items.statement: Operational efficiencies and cost optimization helped improve margins despite elevated input costs.
items.quote: Margins improved despite input cost pressures, supported by operational efficiencies and cost optimization

items.statement: EBITDA expanded faster than revenue as cost optimization and operational efficiencies compensated for inflation caused by geopolitical disruptions.
items.quote: EBITDA outpaced revenue growth as operational efficiencies and cost optimization offset input cost inflation arising from geopolitical disruptions

items.statement: Wiring harness margins were pressured by rising copper prices and the denominator impact of passing through earlier commodity increases.
items.quote: Margins remained impacted by the continued increase in copper prices and the denominator effect associated with the pass-through of absolute copper price increases from prior quarters

items.statement: Crude-linked increases in polymer prices weighed on division margins, which was partially mitigated by European restructuring and cost savings.
items.quote: Higher crude-linked polymer prices weighed on margins, partly offset by transformation and cost-saving initiatives in Europe. Margins improved ~50 bps YoY

items.statement: The commercial vehicle sector sustained its momentum via a recovery in North America, keeping the FY27 outlook favorable.
items.quote: Recovery in the North American CV market sustained CV industry growth momentum; outlook remains favorable for FY27

items.statement: Business growth is projected to continue on the back of a solid order book and upcoming customer program launches during FY27.
items.quote: Strong order book, supported by multiple customer program launches in FY27, expected to drive sustained business growth

items.statement: Slower demand in key exposed markets hindered quarterly revenue growth for the integrated assemblies business.
items.quote: Demand slowdown in key markets with higher business exposure impacted quarterly revenue performance

items.statement: Middle East geopolitical tensions inflated crude prices, driving up costs for polymers, paint, rubber, and other inputs.
items.quote: Crude price inflation due to geopolitical tensions in the Middle East led to higher polymers, paint, rubber and other input costs

items.statement: Passing on higher input costs is anticipated to aid profit margins in coming quarters.
items.quote: Pass-through of elevated input costs to support margins in the coming quarters

items.statement: Progressive margin gains will be driven by input cost pass-throughs alongside ongoing cost optimization efforts.
items.quote: Pass-through of elevated input cost and ongoing cost optimization to drive gradual margin improvement

items.statement: Capital expenditure was INR 1,614 Crores, representing 52% of EBITDA and tracking annual guidance.
items.quote: Capex of INR 1,614 Crores (52% of EBITDA) Capex in-line with growth priorities and yearly guidance

items.statement: The company plans to invest approximately 65 billion rupees over three years to build its third facility with 40 million units of annual capacity.
items.quote: Capex for the third facility to be ~₹ 65 billion, over a period of ~3 years, with manufacturing capability of 40 million units annually at full capacity

items.statement: All organic expansion projects are focused on emerging markets.
items.quote: Emerging Markets (EMs) are the focal point of organic growth, with all expansion being done in EMs

items.statement: The third facility remains on schedule to be commissioned in Q3 FY27 with added upstream integration capabilities.
items.quote: Third facility on track for Q3FY27 commissioning, with added upstream integration capabilities

items.statement: A record-low net leverage ratio of 0.8x leaves the balance sheet well positioned for inorganic acquisitions.
items.quote: Lowest ever Net Leverage Ratio at 0.8x Strong balance sheet provides ample capacity to pursue inorganic growth

items.statement: Integrating Nexans Autoelectric will broaden the group's global market reach starting in Q2 FY27.
items.quote: Integration of Nexans Autoelectric to strengthen global presence and expand the addressable market from Q2FY27 onwards

items.statement: The acquisition of Shenzhen Autocruis will bolster product capabilities in interior and exterior digital mirrors.
items.quote: Shenzhen Autocruis acquisition to enhance product capabilities and competitiveness for exterior and interior digital mirrors

items.statement: The global light vehicle market was slowed by China, while South Asia performed well and upcoming European launches are expected to bolster growth.
items.quote: China slowdown weighed on global LV industry, while South Asia remained a bright spot; Planned European OEM launches expected to support industry growth

items.statement: Automotive production volumes contracted year-on-year due to geopolitical disruptions and the economic slowdown in China.
items.quote: China Slowdown and Geopolitical Disruption Drives Industry De-growth. Note: YoY represents production volume comparison between Q1FY27 vs Q1FY26

items.statement: positive
items.quote: Strong order book, supported by multiple customer program launches in FY27, expected to drive sustained business growth

items.statement: Revenue increased 17% year-on-year and 3% sequentially, outperforming the usual sequential drop from the fourth quarter.
items.quote: Revenue grew by 17% year-on-year and 3% sequentially during the quarter. It is worth noting that historically, Q1 has always seen a sequential decline in revenue over Q4.

items.statement: Normalized profit after tax increased by 55% year-on-year during the first quarter due to business expansion.
items.quote: Normalized PAT grew by 55% in the first quarter of FY '27, driven by the scale-up across our businesses.

items.statement: Copper prices rose 40% year-on-year, resulting in near-term input cost pressures due to lag in passing them through to customers.
items.quote: On a year-on-year basis, copper prices are now up 40%, creating near-term input cost pressures, as these costs are typically passed on to the customers with a lag of 1 or 2 quarters.

items.statement: Crude oil price inflation caused German polymer prices to spike 55% year-on-year and 66% sequentially.
items.quote: Geopolitically driven crude price inflation also pushed polymer prices in Germany up by 55% year-on-year and 66% sequentially.

items.statement: Freight rates climbed significantly with the World Container Index surging 40% year-on-year and 83% quarter-on-quarter.
items.quote: Freight costs were similarly affected, with the World Container Index up 40% year-on-year and 83% sequentially. In certain instances, we incurred additional costs to ensure timely delivery to our customers.

items.statement: Upcoming model launches by European OEMs are expected to drive industry expansion in future quarters.
items.quote: Planned European OEM launches are expected to support industry growth in the quarters and years ahead.

items.statement: The commercial vehicle industry is supported by a North American market recovery and holds a favorable outlook across FY27.
items.quote: On the commercial vehicle side, a recovery in North American market has sustained the CV industry's growth momentum, which is estimated to have grown 5.4% year-on-year. The outlook for the CV industry remains favorable through FY '27.

items.statement: The company's first-quarter capex was aligned with its full-year guidance of INR 6,000 crores plus or minus 10%.
items.quote: We spent INR 1,614 crores on capex in the first quarter, in-line with our full year guidance of INR 6,000 crores, plus/minus 10%.

items.statement: Capex for the third consumer electronics plant is planned at approximately INR 65 billion over three years to build 40 million units of annual capacity.
items.quote: Capex for this third facility is expected to be approximately INR 65 billion spread over a period of 3 years, building manufacturing capacity of 40 million units annually at full scale.

items.statement: Acquisitions Yutaka and Nexans are expected to jointly contribute nearly USD 2 billion to top-line revenue annually.
items.quote: Both of these businesses put together, Yutaka and Nexans should contribute almost close to USD 2 billion to our top-line on annualized basis.

items.statement: Strong Indian market momentum and North American commercial vehicle recovery supported 31% annual revenue growth in wiring harness.
items.quote: Within wiring harness, there was strong momentum in India, combined with the recovery in the North American commercial vehicle business, which drove 31% year-on-year revenue growth.

items.statement: Global light vehicle demand contracted 1.8% year-on-year, driven by a 3.1% decline in China.
items.quote: Globally, the light vehicle industry de-grew by 1.8% year-on-year during the quarter, led by weaknesses in China, the largest automotive market, which de-grew by 3.1%.

items.statement: The company is coordinating with customers to pass through elevated raw material and input costs.
items.quote: We continue to work with our customers to pass on these higher input costs.

items.statement: Copper price increases are passed on to customers with an operational delay of three to six months.
items.quote: So basically, while copper has gone up, there is an impact, as we've explained that on an overall basis, we have a pass-through, which has a lag of 3 to 6 months.

items.statement: Copper prices climbed 4% sequentially during the quarter following consecutive double-digit sequential increases.
items.quote: Copper prices continued to rise up 4% sequentially, following increases of 13% and 16% sequentially in the third quarter of FY '26 and the fourth quarter of FY '26, respectively.

items.statement: The Indian operations experienced headwinds from wage rate inflation as well as elevated copper costs.
items.quote: And now that those markets are coming back, I think you're seeing that the impact of what happened in India with the wage rate increases and the copper hitting harder here.

items.statement: EBITDA expanded 26% year-on-year as EBITDA margins improved by 60 basis points.
items.quote: EBITDA grew by 26% during the quarter, ahead of revenue growth, with EBITDA margin improving by 60 basis points year-on-year.

items.statement: Cost optimization measures helped both MPP and Vision Systems divisions keep margins flat to improving despite polymer cost increases.
items.quote: Nonetheless, both divisions held flat to improving margins aided by ongoing cost optimization initiatives.

items.statement: Motherson invested INR 1,614 crores in capex during the first quarter across growth, backward integration, and maintenance.
items.quote: We spent INR 1,614 crores on capex in the first quarter, in-line with our full year guidance of INR 6,000 crores, plus/minus 10%.

items.statement: Total capital expenditure across the three consumer electronics plants is projected at approximately INR 7,500 crores.
items.quote: The overall capex, including what we have already incurred in this facility, including GF 1, GF 2 and GF 3, should be around INR 7,500 crores.

items.statement: Three plants began operations during Q1, and 10 of the 13 facilities under development are planned to be operationalized this year.
items.quote: 3 plants were operationalised during the quarter, and we currently have 13 facilities at various stages of development, of which 10 are expected to become operational during the course of this year.

items.statement: The third consumer electronics facility remains on track to be commissioned in Q3 FY27.
items.quote: The third facility remains on track for commissioning in the third quarter of FY '27 and will bring added upstream integration capabilities.

items.statement: The aerospace order book expanded by over 17% compared to the end of FY26.
items.quote: Our Aerospace business delivered revenue growth of over 20% year-on-year, while the order book grew by more than 17% since FY '26 end, giving us strong visibility on future growth.

items.statement: The company's leverage ratio dropped to an all-time low of 0.8x, staying well below internal and policy limits.
items.quote: Our leverage ratio is now at an all-time low of 0.8x, well within our financial policy ceiling of 2.5x and our internal aspiration of staying below 1.5x.

items.statement: Motherson announced the acquisition of digital vision company Shenzhen Autocruis.
items.quote: We announced the acquisition of Shenzhen Autocruis, a company primarily engaged in interior and exterior digital vision and monitoring systems.

items.statement: The company finalized the acquisitions of Nexans Autoelectric and Yutaka Giken during July.
items.quote: We also completed the acquisition of Nexans Autoelectric and Yutaka Giken in July.

items.statement: South Asia saw strong automotive growth, while future European OEM launches are projected to aid broader industry expansion.
items.quote: South Asia, led by India, was a clear bright spot and continued to see strong growth. Planned European OEM launches are expected to support industry growth in the quarters and years ahead.

items.statement: Management noted external geopolitical factors as headwinds affecting the market.
items.quote: Of course, there's headwinds in terms of geopolitical and all those kinds of things which affect the market.

items.statement: positive
items.quote: And we're really excited of upcoming quarters and extremely bullish about where we go from here.
